title: Breakout with level editor
lastAssistantText:
Done. I built a complete, self-contained Breakout game with level editor as a single offline `index.html` (28 KB, zero external dependencies).

## Deliverable
- **`index.html`** — the single self-contained file. Open it directly in any browser; works fully offline.

## Features implemented
- **Level editor**: paint bricks with 5 types (varying hit-points, multi-hit bricks show a number), erase, clear all, or load presets.
- **Play your layout**: "▶️ Play Layout" / Play tab launches the ball against your grid.
- **HUD**: live Score, Lives, Level, and remaining Bricks.
- **Restart**: `R` key or the Restart/Replay buttons.
- **Save/Load JSON**: save to `localStorage`, download as `breakout-level.json`, or load a JSON file back.
- **Controls**: keyboard (`←→`/`WASD` move, `Space`/`↑`/`W` launch, `P` pause, `Esc` back to editor), plus mouse drag-to-paint / drag-to-move and full touch support.
- **Editor ↔ Play tabs** now correctly switch modes (a bug I caught and fixed during verification).

## Verification
I wrote a headless browser mock and drove the real game logic through it (no browser was available). I found and fixed two real bugs along the way:
1. `movePaddleKeyboard()` was defined but never called → arrow keys did nothing. Fixed.
2. Header tabs didn't switch modes. Fixed.

Test results (all passing):
- **Editor / save-load / mode-switch / HUD**: 10/10
- **Physics** (brick collision + reflection, scoring, multi-hit, win detection, life-loss when ball falls): 7/7
- **Keyboard** (event delivery + paddle movement during play + pause/resume): 4/4

The game is self-contained (no CDN/fonts/external URLs), and `index.html` passes a JS syntax check.
